yaml:
# W7 Arm A producer: publishes the artefact a consumer will name with `runId:`.
#
# Same shape and purpose as `w5-producer.yaml`, with its OWN artefact name
# (`w7payload`) and its own nonce so a W7 capture can never be confused with a
# re-run of W5-2, and with **no `agentSelector`** — Arm A steers by which agent
# services are running rather than by label (see `w7-poison.yaml`'s header).
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-w7-producer
spec:
  native: true
  steps:
    - name: make_marker
      run: |
        rm -rf out
        mkdir -p out
        printf 'W7-ARTIFACT-SOURCE=producer\nW7-NONCE=a1b2c3d4e5f67001\n' > out/marker.txt
        cat out/marker.txt
    - name: publish
      uploadArtifact:
        name: w7payload
        path: out
